title: Reduced-Rank Autoregressive Models for Matrix Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2609.28841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Matrix time series is a series of matrix data observed over time. Analytical tools for such time series is needed in many applications in finance, economics, engineering and many other fields. To avoid the use of vectorization of the matrices which loses the column and row information, and the vector autoregression framework in traditional time series analysis, \cite{chen2021autoregressive} proposed the Matrix Autoregressive (MAR) Model. The model maintains and utilizes the matrix structure, leading to a substantial dimensional reduction and admitting explicit interpretations, comparing with the vector autoregressive model on the vectorized data. However, the MAR model still encounters difficulties in dealing with large dimensional matrix time series as the coefficient matrices in MAR models are also large. translated_title: 面向矩阵时间序列的降秩自回归模型
translated_abstract: 矩阵时间序列是随时间观测得到的一系列矩阵数据。在金融、经济、工程以及许多其他领域的众多应用中，都需要针对此类时间序列的分析工具。为了避免使用矩阵向量化（这会丢失列和行的信息）以及传统时间序列分析中的向量自回归框架，此前的研究提出了矩阵自回归（MAR）模型。与对向量化数据使用向量自回归模型相比，该模型能够保持并利用矩阵结构，从而实现大幅度的降维，并具有明确可解释性。然而，由于MAR模型中的系数矩阵本身也很大，该模型在处理高维矩阵时间序列时仍然面临困难。在本文中，我们提出通过对MAR模型中的系数矩阵施加降秩约束来实现进一步的降维……
tldr: 本文提出对矩阵自回归（MAR）模型的系数矩阵施加降秩约束，从而实现进一步的降维，以更有效地处理高维矩阵时间序列。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes imposing reduced-rank constraints on the coefficient matrices of the Matrix Autoregressive (MAR) model to achieve further dimension reduction, enabling more effective handling of high-dimensional matrix time series.
